independentApp.passedAppCaseScope: Assertions in those particular cases, using a synthetic network and browser wallet. Each failed execution remains failed.

firefox.observed: Firefox Nightly refused to run as root with XDG_RUNTIME_DIR owned by the runner. No decoder case completed on that engine in this job.

separateStandaloneHtmlGate.countsMethod: The two successful aggregate TAP cases each assert exactly six byte-equal downloads and five rejections. The independent IPv4 parser TAP case is separate.

failureGroups.observed: Timeout on the second fill via exact wrapping-label text. All three snapshots retained an editable textbox with the accessible SEJIRE archive-words name. No successful corrected-phrase recovery is credited.
failureGroups.correction: Use the exact accessible textbox role and name, then fill the corrected value.

failureGroups.observed: The locator expected the initial Save button. The editor displayed its Continue saving action when the journal could not be read. The intended subsequent block was not proven by these two failed executions.
failureGroups.correction: Wait for the ready Continue saving action and check the block after clicking it.

failureGroups.observed: Exact draft comparison spanned editor hydration. Independent comparison of the synthetic JSON found canonical defaults added and no removed or changed original values.
failureGroups.correction: After the editor is ready, assert all original fields remain and snapshot the normalized state before triggering the denied-journal action. Assert exact before/after equality for that action.

failureGroups.observed: The sandbox-host navigation reached the Vite server with the synthetic gateway Host. Vite returned its blocked-host page, and the expected manifest base was missing.
failureGroups.correction: Normalize the upstream Host to the local static server while preserving the sandbox origin seen by the browser.
